description: This file defines the 'soap_fault' class, which models a SOAP fault message used in web service error handling. It includes properties for fault code, fault actor, fault string, and fault detail, as well as a method to serialize the fault into an XML SOAP message.

classes.name: soap_fault
classes.description: Represents a SOAP fault message detailing an error in a SOAP web service transaction.

methods.name: soap_fault (constructor)
methods.description: Initializes a new SOAP fault with specified fault code, actor, string, and detail.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes the fault object into an XML-formatted SOAP fault message.
